note: The languages an operator has enabled on SahajCloud's Sahaj Atlas configuration global
src/config/i18n-options.test.ts, which fails if any of them has no bundle in
public/locales/. That is the whole job: the CMS owns which languages the atlas is OFFERED
in, this build owns which ones it can actually render, and a language enabled with no
bundle renders English while SahajCloud's hreflang promises a page in it.
NOTHING UNDER src/ MAY IMPORT THIS FILE. It is an observation, not configuration. The
widget reads the live global at runtime and falls back to `shippedLanguages` when it can't
— a stale third opinion about what an operator wanted would be worse than no opinion.
`syncedAt` is null because there is nothing to sync yet: SahajCloud's `languages` field is
still on an unmerged branch, and production's global answers with no such field. The list
below is therefore their DOCUMENTED DEFAULT for that state (ATLAS_DEFAULT_LOCALES in
src/lib/atlas/defaultLocales.ts — the launch ten, which is also what this build ships), not
an operator's choice. Run the sync once #645 deploys; until then the assertion holds
trivially, which is correct — the set genuinely has not moved.
